name: read_distance_toida
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd()
for n in ['distance','toida']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(L/f'sources/{n}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
 print(n,'CHARS',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout[:21000] if n=='distance' else r.stdout[:10000]+'\nEND\n'+r.stdout[-9000:])
